text: 其实我是没有打算更新答案的，看到这个问题时忽然间就想起了那个困惑的自己，题主抛出的疑问也恰恰是我自己一直搞不懂的困惑，所以就试着回答了一下，一方面是回答题主的疑虑，另一方面也想试着解开自己的心结。
en: Actually, I had no intention of updating my answer. When I saw this question, I was suddenly reminded of that confused version of myself, and the doubt the asker raised was precisely the confusion I had never been able to make sense of. So I tried answering it — on the one hand to address the asker's doubts, and on the other to try to untie the knot in my own heart.

text: 结果直到写完的那一刻我也一无所获，除了觉得自己更恶心了，一直没想通的事依然还是没想通(笑)。
en: Yet even at the moment I finished writing, I gained nothing — except feeling even more disgusted with myself. The thing I could never work out remained, still, unworked out (lol).

text: 这本来只是我随手写下的一篇拷问自己的心路历程，没想到受到了大家这么多的关注，评论里有骂我的，也有悉心帮我排忧解惑的，在此我都感谢大家，我既然自知是渣男，也做好了接受社会上道德正直之士的唾弃和不耻。
en: This was originally just a casual piece I wrote to interrogate myself, a record of my inner journey. I never expected it to draw so much attention. Among the comments, some cursed me, while others patiently helped me sort out my troubles. I thank you all here. Since I know myself to be a scumbag, I am prepared to accept the contempt and scorn of the morally upright in society.

text: 本来这些对我而言都没什么，反正匿了名，也影响不了我，但最让我惭愧的是一些女孩子说看了我的故事感到很绝望，对爱情彻底丧失了信心，这真的是让我感到诚惶诚恐，所以我决定在原文的开头说一说我的想法，以及回答一些朋友的误会，希望能弥补到我无意间为每一个向往纯洁爱情的姑娘带去的不良影响。
en: None of this would have meant much to me anyway — after all, I posted anonymously, so it could not affect me. But what shames me most is that some girls said reading my story left them feeling utterly hopeless, having completely lost faith in love. That truly fills me with trepidation. So I have decided to say a few words about my thoughts at the beginning of the original text, and to clear up some friends' misunderstandings, in the hope that I can make up for the negative influence I unintentionally brought upon every girl who longs for pure love.

text: 首先，这不是虚构的故事，的确是我的亲身经历，我不想在这一点上费更多的口舌，可能在一些描述上我会用到一些修饰词，但那是为了阅读通顺，我与女神之间发生的的每一件事都是真实的，不存在什么屌丝追了三年没追到手，意淫后面的情节来报复，我不是那么无聊的人，其实我本来想把我们的聊天记录贴上来的，但是后来想到她也玩知乎，虽然是个小透明，但要是无意间看到了，我会感到更加的无地自容。
en: First of all, this is not a fabricated story; it is genuinely my own experience. I do not wish to waste more words on this point. I may have used some embellishing words in places, but only to make the reading flow. Every single thing that happened between the goddess and me was real — there is no such thing as a loser who chased her for three years without winning her, then fantasised about later scenes to take revenge. I am not that bored a person. Actually, I had wanted to paste up our chat logs, but then I thought that she also uses Zhihu. Although she is a mere nobody there, if she happened to see them, I would feel even more utterly ashamed of myself.

text: 还有一些人问我从爱到不爱的过程，怎么会一下子就不爱了，这中间是不是还有其他的原因，我可以明确的回答，没有。
en: Some others asked me about the process from loving to no longer loving — how it could be that I stopped loving all at once, whether there was some other reason in between. I can answer plainly: no.

text: 虽然我们分手的过程因为我实在不想回忆所以写的有些简略，但我肯定是没有其他因素的，兴趣爱好、生活习惯、家庭环境这类的问题都没有。
en: Although I wrote our breakup rather briefly because I truly did not want to recall it, I can assure you there were no other factors — none of the issues like hobbies, living habits, or family background were involved.

text: 请允许我不要脸但实事求是的说，的确是因为我吻腻了她的身体、嘴唇、胸以及她身上的每一寸肌肤后，让我对她再没有了任何的热爱，以前我迷恋她的温柔，她的微笑，在梦中都会想象她在我耳边说悄悄话的样子，但在我得到她身体的那一刻，那些纯洁的美好对我的吸引，都荡然无存了。
en: Allow me, shamelessly but truthfully, to say: it was precisely because, after I had grown tired of kissing her body, her lips, her chest, and every inch of her skin, I no longer felt any love for her. Before, I was obsessed with her gentleness, her smile; in my dreams I would imagine her whispering in my ear. But at the moment I possessed her body, all the attraction that those pure and beautiful things held for me vanished completely.

text: 有人评论说，三年的时间，换来几天的ML，不值。
en: Someone commented that three years in exchange for a few days of ML was not worth it.

text: 呵呵，我也觉得不值，但他妈的我跟本就没把这当成一场交易、一场狩猎，我想的是未来，付出的是真心，可当我们交合的那一刻，上帝好像把我对她所有的的爱都偷走了，我真的真的很无力，真的，我说的这种感觉，常人无法想象，我自己以前也无法想象的，真的是只有经历过的人才会懂，真的，你们中一定有人懂我的，这种分手真的没有让我这种渣子感到解脱、感到快乐。
en: Haha, I also think it wasn't worth it. But bloody hell, I never treated this as a transaction or a hunt. I was thinking of the future and gave my true heart. Yet at the moment we joined together, God seemed to steal all the love I had for her. I truly, truly felt powerless. Really — this feeling I describe, ordinary people cannot imagine it; even I myself could not have imagined it before. It really is something only those who have experienced it can understand. Really, some of you must understand me. This kind of breakup truly did not bring this piece of scum any sense of relief or happiness.

text: (那时我产生了一种错觉，谈恋爱反正就是为了上床的那一刻，为什么要费那么多的真心呢，你伤我愧的，干脆直接约炮就好了，呵呵，这都是后话了。
en: At that time I developed an illusion: dating is, after all, just for that moment of getting into bed, so why bother with so much sincerity? You hurt me, I feel guilty — we might as well just hook up directly. Haha, but that is all by the by.

text: 但女孩子们，请你们一定要清楚，这个世界上，一定是好男人比渣男多的多的，因为这个问题的原因，我向你呈现了我这个渣的所有视角，但请不要让这些成为你们追求纯洁爱情的心结。
en: But girls, please be absolutely clear: in this world there are surely far, far more good men than scumbags. Because of this question, I have shown you every perspective of this scumbag that I am. But please do not let these become a knot in your hearts that hinders your pursuit of pure love.

text: 十个男人里可能有九个都希望做一个风流浪子，怀中的女人每天都不重复，今天看上个皮肤白皙的，明天看上一个笑容甜美的，但随着人生阅历的增长，心智逐渐的成熟，他们有些人渐渐的明白了身为一个男人，应该对爱过的女孩担负起责任，明白了容颜终归会逝去，彼此牵绊着一起走过艰辛岁月的人，才是能够携手终生的爱人。
en: Out of ten men, perhaps nine hope to be a carefree Casanova, with a different woman in their arms every day — today fancying one with fair skin, tomorrow one with a sweet smile. But as life experience grows and the mind gradually matures, some of them come to understand that, as a man, they ought to take responsibility for the girls they have loved; they come to understand that beauty will eventually fade, and that the one who is bound to you and walks through hard times together is the true partner with whom you can spend life hand in hand.

text: 像我这样的人，只是个异类而已，千万不要把我当成男人在爱情中的常态，我相信我也终会有打开心结的那一天，懂得如何真正的去爱一个人。
en: Someone like me is only an outlier. Please do not take me as the norm for men in love. I believe that one day I too will untie the knot in my heart and learn how to truly love a person.

text: 好了，这些就是我想说的所有东西了，谢谢大家的所有的谩骂与理解，希望你们都能找到自己所爱的人。
en: Right, that is all I wanted to say. Thank you all for all your abuse and your understanding. I hope each of you finds the one you love.

text: 哦对了，突然想起来有一个姑娘不知道怎么找到了我的账号，疯狂的私信问我是不是我写的这篇答案，问我到底怎么才能辨别出我这样的男生，她说总觉得她的男友就是我这种人，我特别的忐忑，一直没敢回复。
en: Oh, and by the way, I just remembered: a girl somehow found my account and bombarded me with private messages asking whether I was the one who wrote this answer, and how on earth she could tell a boy like me apart. She said she always felt her boyfriend was exactly the kind of person I am. I was extremely uneasy and never dared to reply.

text: 其实真的是没有办法，如果我自己是女孩子我可能也分辨不出来，不过后来参加表哥的婚礼时，他以前大学同学的一句话插科打诨倒是启发了我。
en: Actually, there really is no way — if I were a girl myself, I probably couldn't tell either. But later, when I attended my cousin's wedding, a jesting remark from one of his former university classmates gave me an idea.

text: 如果你对他的爱迟疑不定时，你就告诉他，等到咱们结婚的那一天，我就把我的第一次给你。
en: If you feel hesitant or uncertain about your love for him, tell him: the day we get married, I will give you my virginity.

text: 我喜欢了女神三年，可我们的爱只经历了短短的一个月，如果她那时对我说这句话，我一定会同意的，那样我们可能会相爱一年、两年、五年，直到毕业，直到工作，直到结婚，就算我对她的喜欢一直是自己骗自己，但那个时候我们已经一起经历了喜怒哀乐，悲欢离合，我应该也是一个懂得爱，懂得责任的堂堂正正的男人了。
en: I liked the goddess for three years, yet our love lasted only a single short month. If she had said those words to me then, I would surely have agreed. Then we might have loved each other for one year, two years, five years — until graduation, until work, until marriage. Even if my affection for her had always been me deceiving myself, by then we would already have gone through joy and anger, sorrow and happiness, partings and reunions together. I should have become a proper man who understands love and responsibility.

text: 本人男，大三学生。
en: I am male, a third-year university student.

text: 我身边有很多渣男，他们有丰富的恋爱经验，通晓男女之间的甜言蜜语，用他们的话说，学校里没有他们追不到手的女孩子。
en: I have many scumbags around me. They have rich dating experience and are well versed in the sweet nothings between men and women. In their words, there is no girl in school they cannot win over.

text: 有时在一起吃饭，他们会给我传授秘籍，告诉我如何从情感菜鸟变成情场老手，就像题主说的，他们是以“原始欲望”为动力，上完床之后就会把女孩甩到一边，寻找新的目标。
en: Sometimes when we eat together, they impart their secret tricks to me, telling me how to go from an emotional novice to a seasoned player. Just as the asker said, they are driven by 'primitive desire': after getting into bed, they cast the girl aside and look for a new target.

text: 但听他们讲追女孩的过程也并没有想象中的轻而易举，也会花费相当的精力，在大学校园里，与女生交流的主要方式还是微信，他们的确会顺着女生感兴趣的话题聊，比如女孩子喜欢一个乐队，问男孩知不知道，如果他们没听说过，会马上上网查相关的资料，了解这个乐队一两首经典歌曲，然后与女孩侃侃而谈，告诉他们自己有多么多么喜欢这个乐队，引起女孩子的共鸣。
en: Yet hearing them describe the process of chasing girls, it is not as easy as one might imagine; it also takes considerable effort. On a university campus, the main way to communicate with girls is still WeChat. They really do steer the conversation towards topics the girl is interested in. For example, if a girl likes a band and asks the boy whether he knows them, if they have never heard of it, they will immediately go online to look up relevant information, learn one or two of the band's classic songs, and then chat away with the girl, telling her how very much they love this band, to strike a chord with her.

text: 但是坦白说，这种行为无法判定对错，因为喜欢一个人的确不能只凭本能，需要一些技巧，甚至是一些谎言，那些渣男错在他们的目的，他们以欲望为目的，欺骗女孩子的行为是为人所不耻的。
en: But to be frank, one cannot judge this behaviour as right or wrong, because truly liking someone cannot rely on instinct alone; it needs some skill, even some lies. Those scumbags are wrong in their purpose: they take desire as their aim, and deceiving girls is something decent people despise.

text: 所以如果题主讨论辨别普通渣男的办法，那就是看他肯不肯为你花费时间和金钱，这真的是一条万能法则，因为他们的手段只是低级的广撒网、多钓鱼，即便你没抵挡住诱惑，和他在一起了，你只要多留心他手机上的社交软件，看他是不是愿意花时间陪你，在必要的地方毫不吝啬的为你花费，就能判定他是不是一个渣男。
en: So if the asker is discussing ways to tell apart ordinary scumbags, it comes down to whether he is willing to spend time and money on you. This really is a universal rule, because their methods are merely low-level 'casting a wide net and fishing broadly'. Even if you failed to resist the temptation and ended up with him, as long as you pay more attention to the social apps on his phone, see whether he is willing to spend time keeping you company, and spend generously where necessary, you can determine whether he is a scumbag.

text: 高级渣很难辨别，他们不会在社交软件上留下任何痕迹，会允许你随意翻看他们的手机，会花时间陪你，在情侣间的每一个节日为你精心挑选礼物，说动人的情话。
en: High-level scumbags are hard to spot. They will not leave any traces on social apps, will let you browse their phones freely, will spend time with you, and will carefully pick gifts for you on every couple's holiday, saying touching sweet words.

text: 但是人只要有欲望就会露出破绽，女孩的心思比较细腻，如果你观察到你的男朋友像是个阅女无数的情场老手，并且在与你确定关系的短时间内迫切的希望和你滚床单，那你就要小心了，不要被甜言蜜语所蒙蔽，抵挡住他的糖衣炮弹，因为他们的目标很可能就在于此。
en: But as long as a person has desire, they will show a flaw. Girls' minds are rather delicate. If you observe that your boyfriend seems like a seasoned player who has been with countless women, and shortly after you became exclusive he urgently wants to get into bed with you, then you must be careful — do not be blinded by sweet talk, and withstand his sugar-coated bullets, because that is very likely precisely their goal.

text: 其实真正爱你的好男生，对啪啪啪这种事的欲望并没有你想象的那么大，他们更愿意和你在一起做各种情侣间亲密的小事，去游乐园、看电影、吃饭或者去旅行，只要和心爱的女生在一起，就能得到荷尔蒙的满足。
en: Actually, a truly loving good boy does not desire sex as much as you might imagine. They would rather do all sorts of intimate little things couples do with you — go to an amusement park, watch a film, eat, or travel. Just being with the girl they love gives them a hormonal satisfaction.

en: Getting into bed is always something that happens naturally, when the time is right. If he shows an urgent desire for it, it is very likely he simply wants to get into bed with you.

text: 大二快结束时，我追了三年的女神和我表白了。
en: Near the end of my second year, the goddess I had chased for three years confessed her feelings to me.

text: 我们本是高中同学，她是班里的学习委员，女神长得很漂亮，是那种小家碧玉的美，眼睛又大又灵巧，嘴唇薄薄的，抿着嘴笑的时候会露出两个浅浅的酒窝，说话的声音也很轻柔，让人听着十分的舒服。
en: We were classmates in senior high school. She was the study commissary of the class. The goddess was very beautiful, the delicate, refined kind of beauty — her eyes large and lively, her lips thin; when she smiled with her lips pressed together, two shallow dimples would show, and her voice was soft and gentle, very pleasant to listen to.

text: 高二分文理班的时候，我们分到了一起，我对她一见倾心，但那时他已经有了男朋友，还是和我一个球队的队员，我只好默默的把这份感情按捺在心底，虽然我很喜欢她，但是破坏别人感情的事我决不为之。
en: In the second year of senior high, when we were divided into arts and science streams, we ended up in the same class. I fell for her at first sight. But by then she already had a boyfriend, who was also a member of my basketball team. I could only silently press this feeling down into the bottom of my heart. Although I liked her very much, I would never do anything to wreck someone else's relationship.

text: 渐渐的，我发现他们的关系并不是很好，经常会吵架，冷战，最后都是女神忍不住去找男友和好。
en: Gradually, I found that their relationship was not very good; they would often quarrel and give each other the silent treatment, and in the end it was always the goddess who could not bear it and went to make up with her boyfriend.

text: 而她的男友却并不老实，我常看到他在晚上篮球训练结束后，和其他女生出去吃饭、看电影。
en: Yet her boyfriend was not faithful. I often saw him, after evening basketball training, go out to eat and watch films with other girls.

text: 终于，在高考结束后，他们分手了，他的男友甩了她，和一个与他考在同一所大学的女生在一起了。
en: Finally, after the university entrance exam, they broke up. Her boyfriend dumped her and got together with a girl who had been admitted to the same university as him.

text: 而我，幸运的和女神考到了同一所大学，我们的关系也有了进展。
en: As for me, I was lucky enough to be admitted to the same university as the goddess, and our relationship made progress too.

text: 在女神陷入失恋痛苦的这段日子，我成为了她受伤心灵的创可贴，每天陪她聊天到深夜，手机从不敢离手，真真切切的体会了一段手机砸脸的日子，她向我倾诉她的痛苦、咒骂他男友的花心，提到伤心之处会痛哭流涕，我想方设法变着花样的逗她开心，带她出去看电影，去游乐园，买她喜欢的公仔。
en: During the days when the goddess was sunk in the pain of a broken heart, I became a plaster for her wounded soul, keeping her company in chat until late at night, never daring to let my phone leave my hand — truly experiencing a period of 'phone smacking me in the face'. She poured out her pain to me, cursing her ex-boyfriend's fickleness; when she reached the sad parts she would weep bitterly. I tried every trick to amuse her, taking her out to films and amusement parks, buying her the figurines she liked.

text: 后来她渐渐的走出了失恋的阴影，人也变得活泼了起来，和我说想学吉他，要我和她一起学，我当即便拿出准备买手机的钱买了吉他，报了和她一起的吉他课，后来我们就一起上课，一起练习弹吉他，她的手指比较娇嫩，一节课下来拨弦的手指会被勒得通红，我很心疼，便随身携带一瓶活血的药膏，每次下课就会给轻轻的给她抹在手指上，这样手指会舒服很多，那也是我第一次摸她的小手，真的好软，真的如书中描写的那般“柔若无骨”。
en: Later she gradually walked out of the shadow of her broken heart and became lively again. She told me she wanted to learn the guitar and asked me to learn with her. I immediately took the money I had set aside for a phone and bought a guitar, and signed up for guitar lessons together with her. After that we attended classes and practised together. Her fingers were rather delicate; after one lesson, the fingertips that had been plucking the strings would be rubbed red. My heart ached for her, so I carried a bottle of ointment to improve her circulation with me, and after every lesson I would gently rub it onto her fingers, which made them much more comfortable. That was also the first time I touched her little hand — truly so soft, truly as the books describe: 'soft as if boneless'.

text: 我们这样的关系维持了一年，我从未敢对她表现出爱慕之情，那时的我比较内向，尤其是对这种男女之情，我一直和自己说再等等再等等，不过等什么连我自己都不知道。
en: We kept this kind of relationship for a year, and I never dared show her my admiration. I was rather introverted back then, especially about this kind of romance. I kept telling myself to wait, just wait a bit more — yet I didn't even know what I was waiting for.

text: 大二刚开学的时候，女神恋爱了。
en: At the very start of my second year, the goddess fell in love.

text: 男生是和她同一个系的同学，他们在一起得毫无征兆，昨天还在和我讨论新上映的电影，转眼就告诉我她恋爱了，我心如刀割，觉得像珍藏的宝物被抢走一般，于是我又回到了高中时的状态，默默的缩到角落，看着她和别人的幸福。
en: The boy was a classmate from her same department. They got together without the slightest warning — just the day before she had been discussing a newly released film with me, and in a blink she told me she was in love. My heart felt cut like a knife; I felt as if a treasured possession had been taken from me. So I returned to my state in senior high, silently shrinking into a corner, watching her happiness with someone else.

text: 可令我没有想到的是，只过了一个礼拜他们就分手了，我问女神为什么，她说她一看就能看出来这个男生只是想和她上床，只是追她的时候隐藏得比较好，在一起后就表现出来了，女神说经历了高中那段感情，她已经能看穿男人外表下面的小心思，谁是真心谁是假意，已经很难逃出她的眼睛了。
en: But what I did not expect was that they broke up after only a week. I asked the goddess why, and she said she could tell at a glance that this boy only wanted to get into bed with her; he had just hidden it well while chasing her, and showed it once they were together. The goddess said that, having been through that relationship in senior high, she could now see through the little schemes beneath a man's outward appearance — who is sincere and who is false could hardly escape her eyes.

text: 我心中窃喜，感觉自己离女神越来越近了，我相信我的真情迟早有一天会打动她的。
en: I secretly rejoiced, feeling I was getting closer and closer to the goddess. I believed my true feelings would move her sooner or later.

text: 由于我与女神走的很近，渐渐的，很多男生开始找我要她的微信，因为我表示过我和她没有情侣关系，只是普通的朋友，他们便以我为跳板，
en: Because I was so close to the goddess, gradually many boys began coming to me for her WeChat. Since I had said that she and I were not a couple but just ordinary friends, they used me as a stepping stone,

text: 得到女神的联系方式，我内心虽极不情愿，但也没有不给他们的理由，我默默的关注着他们的动态，结果发现他们无一例外的都被拒绝了，
en: to get the goddess's contact details. Although I was extremely unwilling in my heart, I had no reason to refuse them. I quietly watched how things went with them, only to find that without exception they were all rejected,

text: 有的可能好了一两个星期，到最后依然逃不过被分手的下场，就连总是向我传授经验的情场老司机都不能幸免，后来我们在一起喝酒，他抱着我的肩膀对我说；
en: some may have lasted a week or two, but in the end still met the fate of being dumped. Even the old hand at the dating game who was always imparting experience to me was not spared. Later we drank together, and he put his arm around my shoulder and said to me;

text: “你这朋友真的不一般，是块难啃的骨头。
en: 'This friend of yours is really something else — a tough nut to crack.

text: 令我感到开心的是，女神对我反而越来越亲近，她遇到什么困难总是第一个想到来找我，遇到什么有趣的事会和我分享，出去玩也只拉我一个人，有时候我恍惚觉得，自己就是他的男朋友。
en: What made me happy was that the goddess grew closer and closer to me instead. Whatever difficulty she encountered, she would always think of me first; whatever interesting thing happened, she would share it with me; when going out to have fun she would only drag me along. Sometimes I would vaguely feel that I was already her boyfriend.

text: 3月份她生日，我送了她一幅我自己画的丙烯画，是她最喜欢的埃菲尔铁塔，女神喜欢的不得了，在朋友圈里晒了出来，还配有一张我高中时的照片，她俏皮的对我说，你是第二个出现在我朋友圈里的男生。
en: In March, for her birthday, I gave her an acrylic painting I had painted myself — the Eiffel Tower, her favourite. The goddess liked it enormously and posted it on her Moments, accompanied by a photo of me from senior high. She said to me playfully, 'You are the second boy to appear in my Moments.'

text: 那天过后，我找了一份兼职，我打算在大学毕业前攒够五万元，带她去巴黎，带她去看一看她最喜欢的埃菲尔铁塔，满足她这个一直以来的心愿。
en: After that day, I found a part-time job. I planned to save up fifty thousand yuan before graduating university, take her to Paris, and show her the Eiffel Tower she liked most, fulfilling this long-held wish of hers.

text: 想到这里，我都会笑出声来，我仿佛看到了我们的未来，她一袭白裙站在我的身前，像个小鸟一样依偎着我，我们在那个浪漫的城市，拥抱、接吻，这个画面在我脑中闪过无数遍，我感觉它已经近在咫尺，总有一天会实现的。
en: Thinking of this, I would laugh out loud. I seemed to see our future: her in a white dress standing before me, nestling against me like a little bird. In that romantic city we would embrace and kiss. This scene flashed through my mind countless times. I felt it was already within reach, and that one day it would come true.

text: 大二下学期的期末考试前夕，女神要我帮她补补会计学，于是我们约在图书馆复习，我知道她并无复习之意，只是拉我出来聊天打闹，一会揪我的头发，一会挠我的痒痒肉，见我埋头做题不理她就抢走我的笔，说让我和她一起挂科。
en: On the eve of the final exams of the second semester of my second year, the goddess asked me to help her catch up on accounting. So we arranged to revise in the library. I knew she had no real intention of revising — she just wanted to drag me out to chat and fool around: now tugging my hair, now tickling my ribs. When she saw me burying my head in the exercises and ignoring her, she stole my pen, saying she'd make me fail the exam together with her.

text: 我说不行，我还得拿奖学金请你吃饭呢，她说也对哦，那你可得好好学，不许走神啊，说着拿起我的手机自顾自的翻看起来，面对女神的反差萌，我只能无奈的摇了摇头，其实心里很喜欢她这些可爱的举动。
en: I said no, I still had to win a scholarship to treat you to a meal. She said, 'True, then you'd better study properly and don't let your mind wander.' As she spoke, she picked up my phone and started browsing it on her own. Faced with the goddess's adorably contradictory behaviour, I could only shake my head helplessly, though in my heart I rather liked these adorable antics of hers.

text: 我开始埋头做题，接下来的二十分钟里，她真的没有再理我，我很纳闷这不是她的风格呀，抬头看了一眼，发现她正全神贯注的盯着我的手机，表情还有些沉重，我偷笑，估计她正玩我新下载的烧脑游戏，遇到难关过不去了。
en: I began burying my head in the exercises. For the next twenty minutes she really did not bother me again. I found it strange — that wasn't like her. I looked up for a glance and found her staring intently at my phone, her expression somewhat grave. I smirked to myself, guessing she was playing the brain-teasing game I had just downloaded and had got stuck at a difficult level.

text: 忽然，女神抬起头，眼眶红红的看着我，我吓了一跳，一时间对这突变的画风有些不知所措，她将我的手机拿起来给我看，我明白了，她在看我的记事本。
en: Suddenly the goddess looked up, her eyes red-rimmed, and stared at me. I was startled, and for a moment at a loss over this abrupt change of scene. She picked up my phone and showed it to me. I understood: she was looking at my notepad.

text: 那上面记载着她什么时候生日、爱吃什么、讨厌什么、喜欢的电影，还有她拜托我的一些事情，以及我的兼职计划与目标，甚至还有我深夜想她时写的矫情的情书。
en: On it were recorded when her birthday was, what she loved to eat, what she hated, her favourite films, as well as some things she had asked me to do, and my part-time work plan and goals — even the sentimental love letters I wrote in the small hours when I missed her.

text: 她一页一页的翻，一页一页的看，我看到她眼眶中有泪水在打转，我更加的手足无措，嘴里不停的重复对不起对不起。
en: She flipped page after page, reading each one. I saw tears welling in her eyes, and I became even more flustered, repeating 'sorry, sorry' over and over.

text: 突然她推开椅子站了起来，猛的扑进我的怀里，紧紧的抱住了我，我怀着忐忑、兴奋与复杂的心情轻轻将手臂环绕在她的后背，她一句话都没有说，我也一句话都没有说，我们彼此沉默着，享受着空气中这一份美妙的味道，我知道，我的愿望就要实现了。
en: Suddenly she pushed back her chair and stood up, then threw herself into my arms and held me tightly. With a nervous, excited and complicated feeling, I gently wrapped my arms around her back. She said not a word, nor did I; we were silent with each other, savouring this wonderful feeling in the air. I knew my wish was about to come true.

text: 记不清过了多久，女神慢慢的放开我，盯着我的眼睛笑，两个小酒窝在我的眼中显得更加可爱，她在我的耳边用比蚊子还要小声音的说:“你这傻子，喜欢我这么久也不告诉我，难道等着我和你表白呀”，我听了也笑，鬼使神差的回了一句“是呀，等你和我表白呢”
en: I cannot recall how long passed before the goddess slowly let go of me, looked into my eyes and smiled; the two little dimples seemed even lovelier in my eyes. She leaned to my ear and, in a voice smaller than a mosquito's, said, 'You fool, you liked me for so long and never told me — were you waiting for me to confess to you?' I laughed at that too, and as if possessed, replied, 'Yes, waiting for you to confess to me.'

text: 女神轻轻的掐了一下我的胳膊，我佯装疼痛，她坐回到椅子上，过了一会像是决定了什么大事一样的表情，拉着我到楼梯间，站好，深吸了一大口气，盯着我的眼睛说:“我喜欢你。
en: The goddess gently pinched my arm, and I pretended it hurt. She sat back down, and after a while, with an expression as if deciding some great matter, pulled me to the stairwell, stood me straight, took a deep breath, looked into my eyes and said, 'I like you.

text: 做我女朋友吧，”我们都愣了一下，觉得有什么不对，突然女神捂着脸说:“错了错了，呸呸呸，是男朋友，啊好丢人”，我大笑，觉得女神真的好萌，在我面前越来越小女人了。
en: Be my girlfriend, then.' We both froze for a moment, feeling something was off. Suddenly the goddess covered her face and said, 'Wrong, wrong, pah pah pah, boyfriend — ah, how embarrassing.' I burst out laughing, thinking the goddess was really so cute, becoming more and more the little woman before me.

text: 我慢慢的牵起她的手，认真的看着她的眼睛说，我们在一起吧，她使劲的点头，说:“嗯”。
en: I slowly took her hand, looked seriously into her eyes and said, let's be together. She nodded vigorously and said, 'Mm.'

text: 我们就这样在一起了，我梦寐以求了三年的女神终于被我追到手了，因为三年的相处时光，让我们刚在一起的时候没有显得多么的尴尬，还是像以前一样一起吃饭一起出去玩，不同的就是现在我可以随意的牵她的小手，我们用同一个吸管喝东西，想亲她的时候可以亲，聊天互称老公老婆，我们就这样沉浸在恋爱的幸福里，每天散发着恋爱的酸臭味，并乐此不疲。
en: And so we got together. The goddess I had dreamt of for three years was finally won over by me. Because of our three years of time together, when we first got together it was not at all awkward; we still ate together and went out together as before. The difference was that now I could hold her little hand whenever I liked, we drank from the same straw, kissed when I wanted to kiss, and called each other husband and wife in chat. Thus immersed in the happiness of love, we gave off the sour smell of romance every day, and never tired of it.

text: 大二的暑假，我们一起去北戴河，线路交通是我规划，旅馆她订，当天到秦皇岛的时候已经是傍晚了，到酒店入住时我才发现她订的是一间大床房，我有些惊讶，因为我知道女神是个很传统的人，我们才刚在一起不久，我以为在这次的住宿问题上她会订两个房间，所以我也特意把订旅馆的事交给她，让她来做定夺，没想到她只订了一间，还是大床房。
en: In the summer holiday of my second year, we went to Beidaihe together. I planned the route and transport; she booked the hotel. By the time we arrived in Qinhuangdao that day it was already evening. Only when we checked into the hotel did I notice she had booked a room with a large bed. I was a little surprised, because I knew the goddess was a very traditional person, and we had only just got together. I had thought that on this accommodation matter she would book two rooms, so I had deliberately left the hotel booking to her to decide. I never expected she would book only one room — and a large-bed room at that.

text: 交钱的时候我回头看了她一眼，她赶紧把头低下，假装玩手机。
en: When paying, I glanced back at her; she quickly lowered her head and pretended to play with her phone.

text: 后来的事，就顺理成章，我们ML了，彼此都是第一次，她说经过这么长时间的相处觉得我就是值得她托福终生的人，甚至连以前坚守的结婚时把第一次交出去这样的决定都抛到脑后了，
en: What followed came naturally: we had ML, both of us for the first time. She said that after spending so long together she felt I was the person worth entrusting her life to, and she even cast aside the decision she had once held firm — to give her virginity only at marriage,

text: 就是想马上成为我的女人，坦白说其实那天乃至那一次旅行我都没打算和女神做那件事，第一晚我倒头就睡了，半夜被她叫醒，然后各种小暗示、
en: she simply wanted to become my woman right away. To be honest, neither that day nor on that trip had I planned to do that with the goddess. The first night I flopped into bed and slept; at midnight she woke me, and then came all sorts of little hints,

text: 小诱惑，我们也就顺理成章的交出了彼此的第一次，接下来的几天旅行，我们除了玩就是做爱，我们倾尽所能，把我们曾经听到过的，能想到的画面都尝试了一遍，
en: little temptations, and so naturally we gave up our virginity to each other. For the remaining days of the trip, apart from sightseeing we made love. We poured out all we had, trying every scenario we had ever heard of or could think of,

text: 就像打开了新世界的大门，我们很快乐，她更爱我了，但我在不知不觉中，改变了。
en: as if opening the door to a new world. We were very happy, and she loved me even more. But without my realising it, I changed.

text: 题主，看到这里你会不会觉得这是一段完整美好的爱情呢，其实我那时也是这么觉得的。
en: Asker, reading this far, do you think this was a complete and beautiful love? Actually, that was what I thought back then too.

text: 可是自从我们ML以后，一切都变了，那次旅行回来后，我变得不想和她聊天、不想见她、不想知道她的一切，我总觉得我对她是有一件任务一样的事情完成了，我清楚的感觉到我不喜欢她了，我自己也陷入了迷茫，我不知道这是为什么，这样的我和那些我看不起的渣男又有什么区别，但我一边自责，一边还是提出了分手，我写了长长的一篇小作文，回忆了以前的美好的瞬间，最后斩钉截铁的提出了分手。
en: Yet ever since we had ML, everything changed. After that trip, I became unwilling to chat with her, unwilling to see her, unwilling to know anything about her. I always felt as if I had finished a task with her, and I clearly sensed that I no longer liked her. I too fell into confusion — I did not know why. What difference was there between me like this and those scumbags I looked down on? Yet even as I blamed myself, I still asked for a breakup. I wrote a long little essay, recalling the happy moments of the past, and finally demanded the breakup without the slightest hesitation.

text: 她伤痛万分，用尽各种方法挽回，各种低声下气，抛弃自尊，我会心疼会难受，但我知道那都不是爱了，我无法想象继续和她在一起，不要脸的说，我那时想的更多的是在那几天我已经亲吻腻了的身体。
en: She was devastated, and tried every method to win me back, in every way humbling herself, abandoning her self-respect. I would feel sorry for her and upset, but I knew it was no longer love. I could not imagine continuing to be with her. Shamelessly speaking, what I thought of more in those days was the body I had already grown tired of kissing.

text: 呵呵，很讽刺吧，我不知道其他男生真实的一面，因为即使他们说给我听，那也不一定就是完完全全真实的。
en: Haha, quite ironic, isn't it? I do not know the true side of other boys, because even if they told me, it might not be completely real.

text: 但这是真实的我，在一段感情里我的想法、我的经历、我的变化。
en: But this is the real me — my thoughts, my experience, and my change within a relationship.

text: 你想知道真实的男生在恋爱中的样子，你想防低级或者高级渣？
en: You want to know what boys are really like in love? You want to guard against low-level or high-level scumbags?

text: 可以，我告诉你方法了，你听我的就没问题，至少在你的后半生不会有更多那样的渣子闯入你的生活。
en: Very well — I have told you the method. Just follow what I say and it will be fine; at least in the latter half of your life no more such scumbags will barge into your life.

text: 但是，我想你很难防住像我这样的人。
en: But I think you would find it very hard to guard against someone like me.

text: 因为，像我这样的渣子，连自己都不知道自己是渣，我们会倾注全部的热情、全部的耐心、全部的爱，直到得到你身体前的那一刻，我们甚至会自己欺骗自己是爱着你的，所以，更不要指望女孩子去辨别真假了。
en: Because a scumbag like me does not even know he is a scumbag. We pour in all our passion, all our patience, all our love — right up until the moment before we possess your body. We may even deceive ourselves into believing we love you. So do not expect girls to tell true from false.

text: “原始欲望”，嗯，也许吧，但我保证这个世界上还是有很多好男人的，他们是以爱为和你在一起的的原动力，和你走完这一生。
en: 'Primitive desire' — hmm, perhaps. But I assure you there are still many good men in this world; they take love as the driving force for being with you, and walk through life with you.

text: 我的故事后面叙述的有些简短了，本来我想好好给你分析一下自己，但恕我实在不想去回忆了。
en: The latter part of my story is told rather briefly. I had meant to analyse myself properly for you, but forgive me — I truly do not wish to recall it.

text: 女神在和我分手后，开始酗酒、纹身，像变了一个人，而我也有了新目标，是个学霸，追了她3个月了，她和我聊天已经从爱答不理变得越来越频繁，甚至开始主动约我出去了，嗯，我想这次是一定是真爱吧。
en: After the goddess broke up with me, she started drinking heavily and getting tattoos, becoming a different person. As for me, I found a new target — a top student. I have been chasing her for three months now; her chats with me have gone from indifferent to increasingly frequent, even starting to ask me out on her own. Hmm, I suppose this time it must be true love.

text: 也许吧
en: Perhaps.

text: 本人男，大三学生，渣男。
en: I am male, a third-year university student, and a scumbag.
